excluded_case.toml_comment: Excluded replacement case: canonical items was '{}' instead of '[]'; superseded by 3993a824-c20e-493d-b3c9-ee8a7753ee59 ('no items' in knapsack_test.cpp) and omitted to avoid duplicate Catch2 TEST_CASE('no items').

cases.name: no items
cases.toml_comment: Reimplements a4d7d2f0-ad8a-460c-86f3-88ba709d41a7 with items = []: TEST_CASE('no items') passes empty std::vector<Item>{}, skipping the outer items loop in maximum_value and returning zero-initialized dp[100] == 0.

cases.name: one item, too heavy
cases.toml_comment: TEST_CASE('one item, too heavy') verifies the inner-loop capacity guard weight >= item.weight (10 >= 100 is false in maximum_value), leaving dp[10] == 0.

cases.name: five items (cannot be greedy by weight)
cases.toml_comment: TEST_CASE('five items (cannot be greedy by weight)') verifies 0/1 DP transition std::max(dp[weight], dp[weight - item.weight] + item.value) selects {10, 21} (21) over four {2, 5} items (20).
